assumptions.instance: AWS c7i-flex.large (2 vCPU, 4 GiB), On-Demand, us-east-1
assumptions.instance_price_source: RunsOn EC2 finder listing for c7i-flex.large, prices fetched 2026-10-20: on-demand $0.0848/hr in us-east-1
assumptions.hardware_equivalence: This VM (2 x86-64 vCPUs, 7.75 GiB RAM, no GPU) is treated as equivalent to that instance class for cost purposes.
assumptions.serving_model: Sequential single-request serving, no batching. A strategy costs instance_price x its measured wall time for the workload's requests. Model load time and idle time are excluded. Both backends share the one instance in the routed deployment.
assumptions.gpu_reference_only: An AWS g5.xlarge (1x A10G) lists at about $1.006/hr On-Demand (Thunder Compute and Wring EC2 guides, Oct 2026). No GPU throughput was measured on this VM, so no GPU per-token cost is derived; the figure is context only.

small.note: backend_seconds covers prefill plus decode, so this is an effective end-to-end rate, not a pure decode rate.
